title: Agent & Workflow Orchestration
summary: This module provides the core components for building intelligent agents and orchestrating complex workflows. It includes various agent types, chains for structured tasks, runnables for flexible composition, and middleware for enhancing agent behavior, security, and context management.

nodes.label: Agent Definitions
nodes.title: Agent Definitions
nodes.description: Defines various agent types and factories for constructing AI agents, from classic ReAct and conversational agents to modern state-graph-based agents with advanced tool-calling and structured output capabilities.

nodes.label: Chains
nodes.title: Chains Module Overview
nodes.description: Provides a framework for linking LLM calls and other components into structured sequences, enabling complex workflows for various AI applications.

nodes.label: Specialized Runnables
nodes.title: Specialized Runnable Implementations
nodes.description: Provides advanced `Runnable` implementations for dynamic configuration, managing chat history, passing data through pipelines, loading components from the LangChain Hub, and routing based on OpenAI function calls.

nodes.label: Tools & Retrievers
nodes.title: Tools and Retrievers Module
nodes.description: Provides tools for agents and diverse retriever implementations for efficient document search and processing. It supports advanced retrieval techniques like multi-query, ensemble, and self-query, and integrates with external search services.

nodes.label: Agent Middleware
nodes.title: Agent Middleware Components
nodes.description: Provides a collection of middleware components designed to enhance agent functionality by managing execution, context, tools, and security. It includes features for resource limiting, error handling, human oversight, data privacy, and specialized tooling for various LLM providers.

groups.label: Core Orchestration
groups.title: Core Orchestration Components
groups.description: These modules define the fundamental building blocks for creating and managing intelligent agents and their operational sequences.

groups.label: Functional Extensions
groups.title: Functional Extensions & Enhancements
groups.description: These modules provide external capabilities (tools, data retrieval) and cross-cutting concerns (security, context management) to augment agent and workflow functionality.
